sources.title: Glenn Barnich, Friedemann Brandt and Marc Henneaux, Local BRST cohomology in gauge theories
sources.locator: Full 150-page arXiv v3 paper. Sections 2.2, 2.3 and Appendix 2.B equations (2.48)–(2.50); Sections 4.1–4.4 on local functions/forms; Section 12.3 on H^{1,n}(s|d).
sources.reading_extent: Read the complete cited sections and adjacent proofs; no claim is made to have read the report’s unrelated classification proofs.

contents.name: Section 2.2: Gauge theories of the Yang–Mills type

source_review.read_extent: Read the complete relevant infinitesimal gauge/BRST transformation passage and the adjacent generator conventions.
source_review.supports: Supplies the local gauge-potential, matter and ghost transformation pattern used to define the Abelian jet differential.
source_review.limitations: The source uses Yang–Mills conventions; the local item fixes the U(1) specialization and preserves the published qft-mg01 dimensionless coupling g and ordinary commuting spinor convention.

source_review.read_extent: Read the complete two-page proof passage, including the N-degree decomposition, homotopy formula, positive-degree exactness, and its relative-cohomology extension.
source_review.supports: Establishes the contracting-homotopy method for independent antighost/auxiliary doublets and states the condition that other transformations not involve the pair.
source_review.limitations: The local proof supplies the general finite-jet graded-algebra statement and checks nilpotence of the precise Abelian differential; no anomaly classification is imported.

contents.name: Sections 4.1–4.4: Local functions, jet spaces, local functionals and local p-forms

source_review.read_extent: Read the complete definitions of jet-local functions, local forms, total derivatives and integrated local functionals.
source_review.supports: Supports the finite-jet and local-form language used in the relative cohomology definition.
source_review.limitations: The local definition fixes compact support, the four-dimensional horizontal differential and the totalization sign explicitly.

contents.name: Section 2.3: Relevance of BRST cohomology; Section 12.3: H^{1,n}(s|d) anomalies

source_review.read_extent: Read the full Wess–Zumino consistency and counterterm discussion in the introduction and the later H^{1,n}(s|d) anomaly discussion.
source_review.supports: Supports the interpretation of local ghost-number-one breakings as relative BRST classes and trivial classes as removable by local counterterms.
source_review.limitations: The proposition proves only the abstract first-order obstruction under an explicitly nilpotent formal Ward differential; it does not import the source’s Yang–Mills anomaly classification or quantum-action-principle assumptions.

sources.title: Norbert Dragon and Friedemann Brandt, BRST Symmetry and Cohomology
sources.locator: Full 75-page arXiv book chapter. Sections 2.1 and 2.4, and Sections 3.1–3.3, especially equations (2.62)–(2.66) and (3.1)–(3.14).
sources.reading_extent: Read the complete cited sections and adjacent arguments from the full book chapter; unrelated material is not claimed as support.

source_review.read_extent: Read the complete graded-algebra conventions and the odd BRST differential properties used in the later cohomology sections.
source_review.supports: Supports graded commutativity, ghost parity, graded Leibniz signs, and commutation of s with spacetime derivatives.
source_review.limitations: The local item fixes the exact U(1) normalization from qft-mg01 and adds no state-space construction.

source_review.read_extent: Read the complete homotopy proof, including the number operator, anticommutator identity and finite homogeneous decomposition.
source_review.supports: Provides an independent contracting-homotopy treatment for polynomial cohomology and verifies the algebraic role of the homotopy.
source_review.limitations: Its displayed basic lemma uses a different jet/operator realization; the item gives a direct proof for the specified doublet generators.

contents.name: Sections 1 and 3.1–3.3: Jet functions, relative cohomology and descent

source_review.read_extent: Read the complete finite-jet definitions and the local-form, ghost-number and relative-cohomology passages.
source_review.supports: Defines local jet forms and H^{r,p}(s|d), with the relative cocycle and equivalence conditions.
source_review.limitations: The item specializes to compactly supported Abelian local forms on R^4 and states the integration convention explicitly.

source_review.read_extent: Read the complete first-breaking argument: formal hbar expansion, nilpotence consistency, locality premise, and counterterm equivalence.
source_review.supports: Directly supports the formal first-order Wess–Zumino obstruction route used by the proposition.
source_review.limitations: Locality of the anomaly is assumed in the item; the source’s quantum action principle and model-specific anomaly analysis are not claimed as established here.

sources.title: Rudolf Schmid, Local cohomology in gauge theories, BRST transformations and anomalies
sources.locator: Full 14-page paper. Section 2, PDF pp. 2–5, on infinite-jet local forms and the horizontal differential; Section 3, PDF pp. 9–12, on BRST cohomology and the Wess–Zumino anomaly class.
sources.reading_extent: Read the complete cited sections and adjacent argument in the full paper; unrelated material is not claimed as support.

contents.name: Section 2: Local Cohomology and the infinite-jet variational bicomplex

source_review.read_extent: Read the complete jet-bundle, horizontal/vertical differential, and local-form constructions on PDF pp. 2–5.
source_review.supports: Provides an independent geometric construction of local forms from the infinite jet bundle and the horizontal differential.
source_review.limitations: The item uses the equivalent coordinate total-derivative construction and compact support on R^4.

contents.name: Section 3: Local BRST cohomology, descent and the Wess–Zumino class

source_review.read_extent: Read the complete BRST bicomplex and anomaly descent passage on PDF pp. 9–12.
source_review.supports: Supports the relation between Wess–Zumino consistency and local BRST cohomology classes.
source_review.limitations: The paper treats non-Abelian gauge-algebra cohomology and explicit Chern–Simons representatives; none of that classification is asserted by the local proposition.

sources.title: Glenn Barnich, Friedemann Brandt and Marc Henneaux, Local BRST cohomology in gauge theories
sources.locator: Full 150-page arXiv v3 paper. Appendix 2.B, equations (2.48)–(2.50), with the complete contracting-homotopy argument.
sources.reading_extent: Read the complete relevant two-page proof and its adjacent explanation in the full paper.

source_review.read_extent: Read the complete homotopy identity and positive-doublet-degree exactness argument.
source_review.supports: Supplies the general formula applied to the specific antighost/auxiliary polynomial B^2.
source_review.limitations: The item explicitly computes its own graded Leibniz signs and does not infer physical-state positivity.

sources.title: Norbert Dragon and Friedemann Brandt, BRST Symmetry and Cohomology
sources.locator: Full 75-page arXiv book chapter. Section 3.1, equations (3.1)–(3.14), on the basic homotopy lemma.
sources.reading_extent: Read the complete relevant homotopy proof in the full book chapter.

source_review.read_extent: Read the complete homogeneous-degree contraction argument and its explicit primitive construction.
source_review.supports: Independently supports the finite polynomial contraction used in the worked doublet example.
source_review.limitations: The concrete B^2 calculation is proved in the local Verification section; no Hilbert-space conclusion is inferred.
